title: Ashdown House
source: Ashdown House: Complete Three-Dimensional Pixel-Horror Level Plan

dolls.name: Mira
dolls.initial_line: The glass became warm before the floor did.

dolls.name: Leela
dolls.initial_line: I left something beside the water.

dolls.name: Arun
dolls.initial_line: The stars did not disappear. The smoke only covered them.

dolls.name: Dev
dolls.initial_line: It was already sparking. I told them.

dolls.name: Sana
dolls.initial_line: Keep the cloth low. Do not breathe above it.

dolls.name: Kabir
dolls.initial_line: I hid when the lights failed.

dolls.name: Nila
dolls.initial_line: One... two... three... I keep losing one.

placements.title: Chain across exterior door
placements.observation: A chain crosses the inside of the front door. Someone wanted this exit secured.

placements.title: Player lantern
placements.observation: A small lantern. It gives just enough light to make the house feel awake.

placements.title: Torn floorplan fragment
placements.observation: A torn plan labels the Library and Main Hall, but the east and south wings are partly burned away.

placements.title: Central cradle
placements.observation: Return the one who counted all, yet was counted by none.

placements.title: House register
placements.observation: The register lists only six resident children. The front door slams, the alarm fails, and smoke begins moving through the house.

placements.title: Disabled alarm bell
placements.observation: The alarm bell is intact, but its wiring has been cut cleanly.

placements.title: Missing alarm battery box
placements.observation: The battery box is open and empty. The failure did not begin with the fire.

placements.title: Catalog cabinet
placements.observation: Arrange the symbol drawers by borrowing year: Moon 1911, Bird 1913, Train 1915.

placements.title: Rolling ladder
placements.observation: The ladder wheels stop beneath three books whose lower edges are worn smooth.

placements.title: Moon borrowing book
placements.observation: A moon-marked lending book was last stamped in 1911.

placements.title: Bird borrowing book
placements.observation: A bird-marked lending book was last stamped in 1913.

placements.title: Train borrowing book
placements.observation: A train-marked lending book was last stamped in 1915.

placements.title: Sliding shelf
placements.observation: The strip says: Pull Book 2, Push Book 5, Pull Book 1.

placements.title: Librarian desk
placements.observation: Inside are the classroom brass key, Arun's borrowing card, Kabir's punishment ledger, and a shelf sequence strip.

placements.title: Classroom brass key
placements.observation: A brass key stamped CLASSROOM.

placements.title: Arun borrowing card
placements.observation: A borrowing card for astronomy books. The name Arun is written in careful block letters.

placements.title: Kabir punishment ledger
placements.observation: A punishment ledger says Kabir hid under desks when the lights failed.

placements.title: Shelf sequence strip
placements.observation: A paper strip reads: Pull 2, Push 5, Pull 1.

placements.title: Mira group photograph
placements.observation: A group photograph shows Mira with a red ribbon near the Library window.

placements.title: Boiler inspection code
placements.observation: The inspection code points toward repeated service-wall repairs.

placements.title: Barred library window
placements.observation: Iron bars cover the Library window from the outside.

placements.title: Second barred window
placements.observation: The second window is barred too. The screws were driven from outdoors.

placements.title: Cold radiator
placements.observation: The radiator is cold, but soot has gathered above its valve.

placements.title: Book return chute
placements.observation: The return chute smells of damp paper. Something once scraped at it from inside the wall.

placements.title: Abandoned book cart
placements.observation: The cart was left halfway through sorting. Every spine faces inward.

placements.title: Overloaded book cart
placements.observation: A wheel has sunk into an old scorch mark.

placements.title: Shelf dedication plaque
placements.observation: The plaque thanks a donor for replacing books lost in an earlier electrical fire.

placements.title: Children's height marks
placements.observation: Seven sets of height marks remain. Only six have initials.

placements.title: Ash footprints
placements.observation: Small footprints weave between the shelves and stop before the moving case.

placements.title: Damaged wall lamp
placements.observation: The lamp wire was pulled loose before heat blackened the plaster.

placements.title: Blackboard fuse sums
placements.observation: The blackboard shows LIGHTS 2+3, PROJECTOR 4+4, HEATER 7+6. Unsafe electrical repairs were routine.

placements.title: Star projector
placements.observation: The projector throws Arun's star drawing across the screen. Its edge reveals the shadow of a seventh desk.

placements.title: Ceramic fuse panel
placements.observation: Enter the fuse ratings for LIGHTS, PROJECTOR, and HEATER in that order.

placements.title: 5A ceramic fuse
placements.observation: A white ceramic fuse stamped 5A.

placements.title: 8A ceramic fuse
placements.observation: A blue-banded ceramic fuse stamped 8A.

placements.title: 13A ceramic fuse
placements.observation: A smoke-stained ceramic fuse stamped 13A.

placements.title: Unlabelled seventh desk
placements.observation: A mismatched seventh desk has no drawer label. A folded cloth steadies one short leg.

placements.title: Classroom seating board
placements.observation: Number the cards Mira 1, Arun 2, Dev 3, Leela 4, Sana 5, Kabir 6, then enter the north row followed by the south row.

placements.title: Six pupil name cards
placements.observation: Six name cards: Mira, Arun, Dev, Leela, Sana, Kabir. There is no seventh card.

placements.title: Arun star slide
placements.observation: A hand-drawn constellation slide signed Arun. The same stars appear in his Library borrowing history.

placements.title: Kabir blue marble
placements.observation: A blue marble is wedged beneath Kabir's scratched desk position.

placements.title: Official attendance sheet
placements.observation: Six official names are arranged by desk. A seventh desk has no name card.

placements.title: Bathroom key
placements.observation: A small key with a cracked porcelain tag: BATH.

placements.title: Hooked wooden pointer
placements.observation: A long classroom pointer with a small brass hook, useful for reaching a drain.

placements.title: Dormitory symbol code
placements.observation: Four bed symbols copied from the attendance page match the lock on the dormitory door.

placements.title: Repeated fuse repair
placements.observation: Cheap wire bridges old fuse contacts. The electrical danger was known and repeatedly patched.

placements.title: Doorway fire extinguisher
placements.observation: The extinguisher coughs out just enough powder to clear the kitchen doorway.

placements.title: Dormitory music box
placements.observation: The bunk notes resolve into a simple numbered melody: Low, High, Middle, Low.

placements.title: Mira ribbon box
placements.observation: A red ribbon marked M. It matches the child in the Library photograph.

placements.title: Dev train wheel
placements.observation: A small train wheel labelled Dev. Its clicking rhythm matches the service pipes.

placements.title: Steamed mirror
placements.observation: Condensation reveals seven circles and the words COUNT AGAIN.

placements.title: Leela missing shoe
placements.observation: A missing shoe stitched with L. It was caught near the drain.

placements.title: Kitchen duty roster
placements.observation: The roster lists six residents and one helper on water duty.

placements.title: Service valve wheel
placements.observation: A valve wheel. It fits the Main Hall boiler door socket.

placements.title: Boiler pressure sequence
placements.observation: The emergency order is Bath, Radiator, Kitchen, Master Isolation.

placements.title: Dev maintenance report
placements.observation: A report notes that Dev warned staff about sparks before the fire.

placements.title: Nila seventh handprint
placements.observation: Seven handprints appear in condensation. The seventh is behind the others, guiding them.
